mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as "totalFinancing", SUM(CASE WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "activeFinancing", NVL((SELECT SUM(CREDIT_LIMIT) FROM TBL_CREDIT_CONTRACT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CONTRACT_STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'EFFECTIVE')), 0) as "totalOutstanding", SUM(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'HIGH' OR ALERT_LEVEL = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "riskAlerts", SUM(CASE WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "upcomingPayments", ROUND(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'CLOSED' OR ALERT_STATUS = 'HANDLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 100), 1) as "complianceRate" FROM TBL_FINANCING_MONITORING WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0

SELECT NVL((SELECT SUM(CREDIT_LIMIT) FROM TBL_CREDIT_CONTRACT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CONTRACT_STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'EFFECTIVE')), 0) as "totalFinancing", NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_CREDIT_CONTRACT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CONTRACT_STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'EFFECTIVE')), 0) as "activeContracts", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as "riskAlerts", NVL((SELECT AVG(INTEREST_RATE) FROM TBL_CREDIT_CONTRACT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CONTRACT_STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'EFFECTIVE')), 0) as "avgCostRate" FROM TBL_FINANCING_MONITORING WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0

SELECT TRUNC(ALERT_DATE) as date_key, ALERT_TYPE, ALERT_LEVEL, COUNT(*) as count FROM TBL_FINANCING_MONITORING WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0
AND ALERT_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE - 7)
AND ALERT_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE - 30)
AND ALERT_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE - 90)
AND ALERT_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE - 365)
GROUP BY TRUNC(ALERT_DATE), ALERT_TYPE, ALERT_LEVEL ORDER BY TRUNC(ALERT_DATE) DESC

SELECT ALERT_TYPE, ALERT_LEVEL, ALERT_STATUS, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(DISTINCT COMPANY_ID) as company_count, COUNT(DISTINCT RELATED_FINANCING_ID) as financing_count FROM TBL_FINANCING_MONITORING WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY ALERT_TYPE, ALERT_LEVEL, ALERT_STATUS
SELECT * FROM TBL_FINANCING_MONITORING WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND ALERT_LEVEL = #{alertLevel} AND ALERT_STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY ALERT_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM TBL_FINANCING_MONITORING WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND ALERT_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'HANDLED') ORDER BY ALERT_DATE ASC

SELECT NVL(GUARANTEE_METHOD, '其他') as code, NVL(GUARANTEE_METHOD, '其他') as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM TBL_CREDIT_CONTRACT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CONTRACT_STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'EFFECTIVE', 'SIGNED') GROUP BY GUARANTEE_METHOD ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT NVL(ALERT_LEVEL, 'UNKNOWN') as "code", CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN '高风险' WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'MEDIUM' THEN '中风险' WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'LOW' THEN '低风险' ELSE '未评级' END as "name", COUNT(*) as "value" FROM TBL_FINANCING_MONITORING WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY ALERT_LEVEL ORDER BY CASE ALERT_LEVEL WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

SELECT NVL(ALERT_STATUS, 'UNKNOWN') as "code", CASE WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'COMPLIANT' OR ALERT_STATUS = 'CLOSED' THEN '合规' WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'WARNING' OR ALERT_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN '预警' WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'BREACH' OR ALERT_STATUS = 'HANDLED' THEN '违约' ELSE '未知' END as "name", COUNT(*) as "value" FROM TBL_FINANCING_MONITORING WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY ALERT_STATUS

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(START_DATE, 'MM'), 'MM') || '月' as "month", NVL(SUM(CREDIT_LIMIT), 0) as "amount" FROM TBL_CREDIT_CONTRACT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CONTRACT_STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'EFFECTIVE', 'SIGNED') AND START_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -#{months} + 1) AND START_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) GROUP BY TRUNC(START_DATE, 'MM') ORDER BY TRUNC(START_DATE, 'MM') ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN GUARANTEE_METHOD = '信用' THEN '银行贷款' WHEN GUARANTEE_METHOD = '抵押' THEN '抵押贷款' WHEN GUARANTEE_METHOD = '质押' THEN '质押融资' WHEN GUARANTEE_METHOD = '保证' THEN '担保融资' WHEN GUARANTEE_METHOD = '组合' THEN '组合融资' ELSE '其他融资' END as "name", NVL(SUM(CREDIT_LIMIT), 0) as "value" FROM TBL_CREDIT_CONTRACT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CONTRACT_STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'EFFECTIVE', 'SIGNED') GROUP BY CASE WHEN GUARANTEE_METHOD = '信用' THEN '银行贷款' WHEN GUARANTEE_METHOD = '抵押' THEN '抵押贷款' WHEN GUARANTEE_METHOD = '质押' THEN '质押融资' WHEN GUARANTEE_METHOD = '保证' THEN '担保融资' WHEN GUARANTEE_METHOD = '组合' THEN '组合融资' ELSE '其他融资' END ORDER BY NVL(SUM(CREDIT_LIMIT), 0) DESC
